'''Uday Maitra''' is an Indian organic chemist and a professor in the department of organic chemistry at the [[Indian Institute of Science]].<ref name="Faculty profile">{{Cite web |url=http://orgchem.iisc.ernet.in/faculty/um/ |title=Faculty profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Institute of Science |access-date=1 December 2016 |archive-date=15 March 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180315000845/http://orgchem.iisc.ernet.in/faculty/um/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Department of Organic Chemistry">{{Cite web |url=http://www.fist-dst.org/html-flies/pdf/ociiscw.pdf |title=Department of Organic Chemistry |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Institute of Science}}</ref> He is known for his studies on molecular tools and [[supramolecular assembly|supramolecular assemblies]].<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=175 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2016 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> He is a recipient of the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards.<ref name="Chemical Sciences">{{cite web | url=http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm | title=Chemical Sciences | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=2016 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120912012851/http://www.csir.res.in/external/heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm | archive-date=2012-09-12 }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Born in Durgapur, Maitra secured B.Sc. in Chemistry from Presidency College(then affiliated to [[University of Calcutta]]) and PhD in 1986 from [[Columbia University]], working under the guidance of [[Ronald Breslow]] and did his post-doctoral studies at the laboratory of Paul A. Bartlett of the [[University of California, Berkeley]]. His studies are characterized by the new methodologies he employed  in developing supramolecular assemblies and molecular tools like receptors, tweezers and gelators.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners |date=2016 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research}}</ref> He has published his researches in a number of peer-reviewed articles; [[ResearchGate]], an online repository of scientific articles has listed 142 of them.<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Uday_Maitra |title=On ResearchGate |date=2016 }}</ref> He has mentored many doctoral scholars<ref name="Singh2009">{{cite book|author=Singh|title=Conceptual Problems In Organic Chemistry|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=uNyc0JOO2uYC&pg=PP7|date=1 September 2009|publisher=Pearson Education India|isbn=978-81-317-2463-7|pages=7–}}</ref> and is involved in initiatives for the popularization of chemistry.<ref name="Chemistry is boring because of the way it is taught in schools">{{Cite news |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/bangalore/lsquoChemistry-is-boring-because-of-the-way-it-is-taught-in-schools/article15505116.ece |title=Chemistry is boring because of the way it is taught in schools |date=1 January 2011 |newspaper=The Hindu|author=Staff Reporter }}</ref> He has participated in seminars to deliver plenary/invited addresses, was a member of the Indian delegation at the Indo-German Symposium on ''Frontiers of Chemistry'' organized by the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur<ref name="Frontiers of Chemistry">{{Cite web |url=http://www.iitk.ac.in/infocell/announce/frontiers/indian_parti.htm |title=Frontiers of Chemistry |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur |access-date=1 December 2016 |archive-date=1 May 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130501113026/http://www.iitk.ac.in/infocell/announce/frontiers/indian_parti.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> and is a member of the editorial board of the Asian Journal of Organic Chemistry.<ref name="Editorial Board">{{Cite journal |url=http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/10.1002/(ISSN)2193-5815/homepage/2157_edbd.html |title=Editorial Board |date=201 |publisher=Asian Journal of Organic Chemistry|doi=10.1002/(ISSN)2193-5815 |doi-access=free |url-access=subscription }}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2001, for his contributions to chemical sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref>

He is currently the Chair of the IUPAC Committee on Chemistry Education and is an IUPAC Science Board member.{{portal|India|Chemistry}}
